name: Distilled Water brews with a Herb, then Sacrifice draws a card since it was brewed
notes: Distilled Water's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Brewing is an alternate cost declared via a YESNO decision at materialize time (sacrifice a Herb instead of paying reserve); a Blightroot (HERB token) is seeded onto the field to pay the Brew - One Herb cost. Sacrificing Distilled Water afterward checks the O1OU62Zx2Y_wasBrewed decision-queue variable set during that declare-brew flow and draws a card.

rulesClauses: Sacrifice Distilled Water: If Distilled Water was brewed, draw a card.
